title: Isabel RM Possible NDE 6920
content: The 17th of November 2011 I went to the operating room for a lipoma [tumor of the fatty tissue] operation in the right armpit, nothing serious, only the risk of any operation with a general anesthesia. Even so, I was having a premonition that something was not going to come out okay. The anesthetist got the wrong file and she started to measure my throat to do a tracheotomy. According to her, I had problems with the tubes in my last operation. She was a beginner and she also was wrong with the guy before me. Anyway, I had to go to my family doctor and he sent me to the hospital’s reception to confirm that everything was OK because I was not at ease. At the time of the operation, they sent me to the wrong wing of the hospital because the nurse told me there were not beds available where they had sent me. They hurried me up because they were looking for me for an hour around the hospital, by their own mistake. I handed them the admittance papers where they ask you if you have allergies or what medicines you are taking. I am allergic to penicillin. They poked me three times to insert the tubes. The doctor complained, because according to him, this operation was a matter of 'sthetics. I heard him saying it to someone when I was signing papers. Anyway, the time for the anesthesia came. I saw the face of the anesthetist and thank God, he was not the same as before. From then on, there were a lot of people in the operating room: 3 nurses, the door guard, the one that inserted the tubes, the doctor and the anesthetist. It looked like a party. When they administered the anesthesia, I felt my shoulder being touched and a voice tells me ‘Soon you will be here’. In that moment, my impulse was to get up; I did and left my body. It gave me time to see the skeletons of the nurses, as when you see an X-ray. All was dark and I started to feel cold with a humid sensation. I even smelled like something dirty. When I sat up I bumped with something that contained metal, it was the noise of metals, as if tripping on a small table that contains metal. I noticed the bump on my leg. The voice told me, ‘This way’. In darkness I went around what I suppose was the operating table. To my amazement, I was not seeing anything, only darkness. I saw at the rear, a light, as if far away. I took a step to go to it but it started to move up, down, to both sides. I felt it was going away so I followed this man. I noticed how I got a hold of him, very gently, and I started to go up. I was seeing a light. I was thinking that it is the light of the operating room, the lamp. I wanted to see the operating room but I was not seeing anything. In a moment, I felt myself alone again in the darkness. I looked down and I saw a man on a hill waving his arms, signaling to me while saying, ‘eh-h-h, here, down here’. I started to feel fearful. I did not know what to do. He started to come up to me and took me down. Once down, I saw a tree and said, in wonder, in a loud voice, ‘The tree of life’. They showed me an image of the Cabala, as if in a photo. At that moment, a man came from behind me. He stared at me with such peace and so much love in his face, with such warmth that I did not fear. It gave me confidence and I stayed there. I was looking at him in wonder because this man had very skin golden, chestnut hair, had clear eyes and was dressed in brown. He was touching like some lights in the tree while turning and smiling again with all that warmth and love. There was a moment that I thought, 'wait, wait, this is real'. While seeing around me, I felt myself really there, I even felt the breeze blowing and I saw how it was moving what looked like wheat. I am not sure, because I was seeing black and white. But they looked like wheat stalks moving with the wind. He told me again, ‘Soon you'll be here but at this moment, starting now, this is going to be your place; starting now all is going to be okay in a little while, and all is going to come out okay’. I asked him mentally about a problem I had and he affirmed with the nod of his head. We sat under the tree, he told me to ‘be ready, many things are going to happen, there are going to be changes, but the changes are for the better’. Mentally he was telling me and I was affirming with my head. I was very worried when seeing like on a movie screen, a hole in the galaxy. Then I saw a quarter of a big orange celestial body, as if in the corner of a panoramic view. Then suddenly appeared a gray planet as if being pushed by something. It moved, pushed again, and went up in such a way that I saw it pass above my head. It was gray and with craters. I saw the craters perfectly. The next thing that was shown to me was a sunny, apparently normal day, a landscape with the sky, some boulders, and the fields. Suddenly I saw a gust of dust coming into the atmosphere at a great speed, in such way that I looked away. Next, I saw the water turned to mud dragging rubble, much rubble. Because of the nervousness of what I had seen, I started to joke and I said, ‘Not bad that I am not going to be there to see it, ha-ha’. Then I got up and stopped abruptly as if gripped by panic: I saw how the earth opened up below my feet in such way that I felt it, felt as if I was falling in the vacuum. Then another image was shown. It was a sunny day in the mountains where there were people dressed in white. I was seeing them from the back. A blond girl with her hair tied up then suddenly I saw other people dressed in white going uphill. They looked as if they had a lot of energy and a lot of light. When I saw them, I raised my hand as if in a sign of victory and much happiness, a euphoric happiness that I have never experienced. I saw the words ‘faith’ and ‘hope’ in big letters: more than seeing them, I felt them. The people with their back to me were gesticulating with their hands, greeting them with happiness, then he tells me: ‘Hurry, somebody is coming: perhaps somebody that you know or that you will know’. I looked around me and I saw a small shadow getting closer. I put my head, as if inside something, and saw a little black dog that was asleep. He opened his eyes and looked at me. The man told me: ‘No, not that. That will be here in a few days’. Then he said, ‘Let's see how you receive it. Start practicing for when you are here’. Then this shadow lay down and I called him Afri, and it did not sound good to me so I called it Coffe: a friend’s female dog that I was taking care of for some days. I thought it was her. I got very happy and I started to run and play with her around there. Then I opened my eyes and saw the operating room, but I wanted to continue to be there. I don't know how, but I returned and I saw this man again. I started to think 'this is not real. Disappear'. I said disappear several times and he disappeared but continued talking to me in the darkness. There was not much light, it was as if I was in some part of the cosmos. I was only seeing in color some things. He told me, ‘Come, get close. I am going to show you somebody that is going to be here with you.’ I started to walk in the darkness as if looking for his voice and trying to see something and all of a sudden, he showed me a giant poster with lights and the face and the body of this person, because it was the whole size. I was impressed and started to walk backwards until I felt I was falling in the vacuum, falling at an incredible speed, I was feeling the speed in my face when falling. Next, I woke up at the operating room. I sat up with an abrupt movement and I started to cry. This is my story. I tell it in case I can help somebody with something, to understand or be prepared. Thanks for your time. Before my experience, I was in a very bad shape, very depressed, very alone, without hope before going into the operating room. I had a wish to die there, not to wake up again. I was ready to depart from this world; I wanted to die there: that day. Afterward I have a new faith, renewed, and much hope. I have been investigating if what I saw there, what was shown to me could be true: it all points that way. I am not scientific, but I have spoken with an astrologer from here in Spain and it looks like some wave is coming from the center of the galaxy. There are videos on ‘YouTube’.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Cold, humid sensation; smelled 'like something dirty'; darkness; bumped into something metal and noticed the bump on her leg; later panic and falling sensation.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Went around what she supposed was the operating table in darkness; followed a distant light that moved; held a man gently and 'started to go up'; later 'falling in the vacuum' at incredible speed.

arrival.other_being_detail: A man with 'very skin golden, chestnut hair, had clear eyes and was dressed in brown' who communicated guidance and reassurance; also an earlier 'voice' and a man on a hill waving.

environment.environment_other_detail: Tree identified by experiencer as 'The tree of life'; breeze moving what looked like wheat; later imagery like a 'hole in the galaxy', a gray cratered body/planet passing overhead; landscapes with boulders/fields; water turned to mud dragging rubble; mountains with people in white; 'as if in some part of the cosmos'; a 'giant poster with lights'.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Returned to awareness of the operating room twice: 'Then I opened my eyes and saw the operating room... I don't know how, but I returned'; final return described as 'falling in the vacuum... Next, I woke up at the operating room.'
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He told her: 'be ready, many things are going to happen, there are going to be changes, but the changes are for the better' and 'Start practicing for when you are here'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Lipoma operation in right armpit under general anesthesia.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Prophetic/visionary scenes (galaxy 'hole', celestial bodies, disasters; 'faith' and 'hope' words; meeting/recognizing a dog; 'giant poster with lights' of a person).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE into darkness/void with distant light; encounter with beings and a tree/landscape; multiple vision sequences; briefly reawakened to operating room then returned to the experience; final rapid fall back to body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to the operating room and then re-entered the experience, seeing the man again.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Saw nurses as skeletons 'as when you see an X-ray'; 'tree of life' and an image of the Cabala; visions of cosmic/planetary phenomena and disasters; words 'faith' and 'hope' felt/seen; interaction with a dog; a 'giant poster with lights' showing a person.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Soon you will be here.” “This way.” “The tree of life.” “Soon you'll be here but at this moment, starting now, this is going to be your place; starting now all is going to be okay in a little while, and all is going to come out okay.” “Be ready, many things are going to happen, there are going to be changes, but the changes are for the better.” “Hurry, somebody is coming: perhaps somebody that you know or that you will know.” “No, not that. That will be here in a few days”. “Start practicing for when you are here”.
